layout.buttonFallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
layout.automatic: This e-mail was sent automatically. Please do not reply to it.
layout.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this e-mail.

auth.confirm_email.subject: Please confirm your e-mail address
auth.confirm_email.heading: Confirm your e-mail address
intro: Hello {name},
welcome to Kalora. Please confirm your e-mail address so that we can reach you about {salon}.

auth.reset_password.subject: New password for Kalora
auth.reset_password.heading: Set a new password
intro: Hello {name},
a new password was requested for your account. The link is valid for one hour.

auth.staff_invitation.subject: {salon} invites you to Kalora
auth.staff_invitation.heading: You have been invited
intro: Hello {name},
{salon} invited you to create your own access to Kalora and see your calendar.
The invitation is valid until {expires}.

booking.request_received.subject: Your appointment request at {salon}
booking.request_received.heading: Request sent
intro: Hello {name},
your request has reached {salon}. You will get an e-mail as soon as the salon replies.

booking.confirmed.subject: Your appointment at {salon} is confirmed
booking.confirmed.heading: Appointment confirmed
intro: Hello {name},
your appointment at {salon} is confirmed. We look forward to seeing you!

booking.declined.subject: Your appointment request at {salon}
booking.declined.heading: No appointment, unfortunately
intro: Hello {name},
unfortunately {salon} cannot accept your appointment request.

booking.expired.subject: Your appointment request at {salon} has expired
booking.expired.heading: Request expired
intro: Hello {name},
{salon} did not answer your request in time, so it has expired. We are sorry about that.
You can request a new appointment right away.

booking.cancelled_by_customer.subject: Your appointment at {salon} was cancelled
booking.cancelled_by_customer.heading: Appointment cancelled
intro: Hello {name},
you cancelled your appointment at {salon}. The salon has been informed.

booking.cancelled_by_salon.subject: Your appointment at {salon} was called off
booking.cancelled_by_salon.heading: Appointment called off
intro: Hello {name},
unfortunately {salon} had to call off your appointment. We are sorry about that.

booking.reminder.subject: Reminder: your appointment at {salon}
booking.reminder.heading: Your appointment is coming up
intro: Hello {name},
this is a reminder of your appointment at {salon}.

booking.new_for_salon.subject: New appointment request from {name}
booking.new_for_salon.heading: New appointment request
intro: A new appointment came in through the booking page.

booking.cancellation_for_salon.subject: {name} cancelled an appointment
booking.cancellation_for_salon.heading: Appointment cancelled
intro: {name} cancelled the following appointment. The time is free again.
